```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

pacman::p_load(
  here,
  dplyr,
  readr,
  flexdashboard
)

nhanes <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(-1) # drop the unnamed row index written by write.csv()
```

```{r summaries, include = FALSE}
# Average systolic blood pressure over up to four readings, built the same
# way as in Assignment 3, Exercise 4. rowMeans() returns NaN when all four
# readings are missing, so those become NA.
nhanes <- nhanes |>
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(across(c(systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2,
                                systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4)),
                       na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_sbp = if_else(is.nan(avg_sbp), NA_real_, avg_sbp)
  )

# Share of all participants aged 21 or older
pct_21_plus <- round(100 * mean(nhanes$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE), 1)

# Share of participants with an SBP reading whose average is above 120 mm Hg
pct_sbp_above_120 <- round(100 * mean(nhanes$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
```

```{css}
/* Scale the saved PNG to fill its panel while keeping its proportions */
.chart-stage img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
}
```

```{r age-plot}

knitr::include_graphics(here("figures", "ex2_age_histogram.png"))
```

Row {data-height=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Participants aged 21 or older

```{r gauge-21-plus}
gauge(
  pct_21_plus,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  symbol = "%",
  gaugeSectors(
    success = c(60, 100),
    warning = c(30, 59.9),
    danger  = c(0, 29.9)
  )
)
```

### Participants with average systolic blood pressure above 120 mm Hg

```{r valuebox-sbp}
valueBox(
  value = paste0(pct_sbp_above_120, "%"),
  icon = "fa-heartbeat",
  color = "#D55E00"
)
```
